mail.tagline: 2 GB of free storage. Less spam. Mail from anywhere.
mail.welcome.subject: Welcome to {provider} Mail!
Your new {provider} Mail account is ready
mail.welcome.body: Hi {user},|Welcome to {provider} Mail! Your new address is {address}.|You can read your mail from any computer with an Internet connection: just go to {host} and sign in.|Keep your password safe. If you forget it, we will text a code to the phone number on your account ({num}).|Thanks for choosing {provider}.|The {provider} Team
mail.bank.hello.subject: Go paperless with {bank}
Your e-Statements from {bank}
mail.bank.hello.body: Dear customer,|We have matched this e-mail address to your account ending in {last4}. From now on your statement will arrive here every Monday, free of charge.|{bank} will never ask for your password or PIN by e-mail.|Sincerely,|{bank} Customer Service
mail.bank.stmt.subject: Your {bank} e-Statement is ready
{bank} weekly statement, account ending {last4}
mail.bank.stmt.intro: Here is the activity on your account ending in {last4} for the week of {week}.
Below is your statement for the week of {week}, account ending in {last4}.
mail.bank.stmt.outro: Questions? Call us at {phone} or visit any branch.|{bank} will never ask for your password or PIN by e-mail.

mail.news.first.body: Thanks for shopping with us! You are now on the {biz} mailing list. Look out for deals and news from your friends in {district}.

mail.spam.lottery.subject: CONGRATULATIONS!!! You are a WINNER
Your claim number is waiting
Re: your winning ticket
mail.spam.lottery.body: Dear Winner,|Your e-mail address was selected in our international draw and has won the sum of $1,500,000. To claim your prize, reply with your full name, address and phone number.|Yours faithfully,|{name}, Claims Agent
mail.spam.watches.subject: Luxury watches at 90% off
Replica watches - perfect copies
mail.spam.watches.body: Hello friend,|Why pay full price? Top brand watches, perfect copies, shipped to your door in 3 days. Visit our store today, stock is limited!
mail.spam.home.subject: Earn $5000 a month from home!!!
Work 2 hours a day, earn more
mail.spam.home.body: Are you tired of your job? Thousands of people are making $5000 a month working from home just a few hours a day. No experience needed! Reply YES for more information.
mail.spam.loan.subject: You have been PRE-APPROVED
Lowest rates of the year - act now
mail.spam.loan.body: Congratulations, you have been pre-approved for a loan of up to $25,000. Bad credit OK. No questions asked. Reply within 48 hours to keep your rate.
mail.spam.software.subject: Office software for only $49
All the software you need, cheap
mail.spam.software.body: Office, photo editors, operating systems... all the software you need at a fraction of the price. Instant download. Satisfaction guaranteed!!!
mail.spam.stock.subject: HOT STOCK ALERT: this one will triple
Get in before Monday
mail.spam.stock.body: This small company is about to announce BIG news. Get in before the price goes through the roof. This is not a drill. Buy now!!!
mail.spam.diploma.subject: Get a college diploma in 2 weeks
The degree you deserve
mail.spam.diploma.body: Get the degree you deserve. Bachelor, Master, even PhD. No exams, no classes. Based on your life experience. Call now.
mail.spam.money.subject: URGENT: please reply
Confidential business proposal
mail.spam.money.body: Dear sir or madam,|I am writing to ask for your help moving a large sum of money out of my country. You will be rewarded with 30% for your trouble. Please reply in confidence.|{name}
